changeSet.author: ticketwave
changeSet.comment: Refunds: override_delta/override_reason record a support/admin agent's manual fee waiver applied when approving a refund. override_delta is the signed difference between the policy-computed amount and what the agent actually approved (positive means the agent refunded more than policy alone would have). override_reason is the agent's mandatory explanation for that delta. Both stay null for a refund settled without an override.
